o: Following Charlie's victory against Heaven's army, the Hotel is packed with new residents. Though, to Charlie's dismay, many of her new guests seek revenge not redemption. Meanwhile, the Vees try to capitalise on Hell's instability and use the growing tensions with Heaven to their own advantage.

eps.o: Charlie's victory against Heaven has sinners flocking to the newly rebuilt Hazbin Hotel. But can she make sure they're all there for the right reasons? Meanwhile, Vox reveals his plan for the Vees to gain their ultimate victory.
Sir Pentious' redemption creates a stir in Heaven, but not everyone is happy to see a sinner redeemed.
Charlie invites Voxtek to do a piece on the Hotel and Pentious' redemption. But she will need hard proof to convince her skeptical guests.
Charlie tries to do damage control by going live on television! Meanwhile, Alastor reaches his final straw.
Vox hosts a rally for his increasing supporters. Meanwhile, Charlie looks to Heaven for help.
Vox leads the overlords toward war with Heaven. Tensions run high at the hotel and Husk returns to his old ways.
Vox unveils his secret weapon, giving Heaven their final warning.
Vox (and the Vees, I guess) is hosting a party so everyone can watch him take over Heaven - and you're all invited!
